title: No Waffle Plates
text:
No Waffle Plates. Let me first say I am a real hard case when it comes to kitchen gadgets. They have to really WOW me to get a good review. I was hoping that this would be a WOW considering the cost. More of a EH.. Let's start with the good.

It's a good size. I have an older version of this that the plates don't come out of. Have used it for years and love it. This is probably twice as big and easier to clean.
It's heavy and seems pretty well made.
The plates are very heavy and well made compared to other grills like this that I have reviewed. They also have their own heating elements built in so that there is a better heat distribution.

The cons:
No waffle plates with this model. I was so hoping to get rid of a waffle iron and use this. That was not clear in the ordering information I had. I see it on the regular product page way down at the bottom. Easy to overlook.

The sear function is very brief. Have your meat ready to go and don't dally or you will miss it and it can not be restarted for 30 minutes.

My machine has an area of chipped and blistered paint right out the box along the edge where the plates sit. Not sure how long that will hold out under heat stress.

Getting the lid to hold position for the broil feature is a tricky balancing act.

The plates are removable, but they are also kind of tricky to get in and out. You have to wiggle around to get them to seat.

Very short cord which is difficult to reach an outlet with.

Sticky residue on the hinges and some of the moving parts that was awful to get off before first use.

Personally I wouldn't spend the money for this. It is disappointing in a lot of ways.

product_metadata.title: DeLonghi CGH1030D Livenza All-Day Grill, Griddle and Waffle Maker Silver Large
features: 7 cooking functions: contact grill & panini press, open full grill, open full griddle, half grill half griddle, waffle mode and oven broiler mode
Removable, dishwasher safe die-cast plates with embedded heating elements
Digital control LED panel with two knobs to set the temperature control of the two plates
Large cooking surface of 14.5in x 9in (doubles to 14.5in x 18in once opened)
Hanging self adjustable hinge won't crush small sandwiches or large pieces of meat while still cooking it through
Includes 1 set of non-stick Grill plates, 1 set of non-stick Griddle plates, 1 set of non-stick Waffle plates, Oil Drip Cup and Cleaning Tool
description: Get the bold flavors you love from grilling—in the comfort of your kitchen. Ideal for use during the winter or as a portable cooking option, this multifunctional grill fits on the countertop but offers plenty of space to cook for a crowd. The best part? The All-Day Grill comes with three sets of plates that transform it into a grill, griddle or waffle iron, allowing you to make a huge variety of meals with one compact appliance. Make crispy, flavorful Panini and cuts of meat in the contact grill position, or grill veggies over open heat in the open position. You can even float the top grill over steak or crostini for a broiler effect. Use the griddle plates to cook up a big batch of pancakes, or swap in the waffle plates to enjoy perfectly fluffy homemade waffles. However you choose to use the All-Day Grill, the embedded heating element ensures your food will cook evenly for delicious results. Because excess fats and oils drain into the included drip tray, it’s easy to cook healthy, delicious meals—and to clean up afterwards.
